paragraphs: The SL63 AMG has been part of the SL range since 2006, and across its three generations has used two different AMG V8 engines — from the M157 5.5-litre through to today's M177 4.0-litre. The full breakdown by engine code is below.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every SL63 AMG on the road.

cards.body: A 5.5-litre twin-turbo V8 fitted to the SL63 AMG from 2006 to 2021, across the R230 and R231 generations. Known for valve seal and coolant system wear over time — see the callout above. We replace valve seals, coolant components, timing chains and bearings as standard on every M157 rebuild.

A 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8 fitted to the current R232-generation SL63 AMG from 2021 onwards. The same established AMG V8 pattern applies — valve seal and coolant system wear — and we service it to the same standard as the M157.

compatibility.intro: Because the SL63 AMG spans two distinct AMG V8 engines across three generations, fitting the wrong replacement — or assuming an M157 part will work on an R232 car — risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (M256) via registration or VIN
Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic SL quote — it protects you from paying for parts that don't fit your actual car.
